name: Ogre Hunting Party
source: WEB, Grade 2a warband, converted from mordheimer.net (/docs/warbands/grade-2a-warbands/ogre-hunting-party) on 2026-10-10.

heroSlots.notes: A lone Ogre hunter followed by a band of Gnoblars and his half-tamed Sabretusk cubs. Each warband must have exactly one. Gets no free dagger.

specialRules.name: Huuuuge
specialRules.description: Causes Fear, is a Large Target and never takes All Alone tests. May never have Ithilmar, Gromril or heavy armour. Adds 20 + his Experience to the warband rating.

specialRules.name: Slow Witted
specialRules.description: Needs twice the usual Experience for each advance.

specialRules.name: Don't Fight with Eating Knives
specialRules.description: Never fights with a dagger in close combat. If he has no other weapon he fights unarmed: no -1 Strength penalty, but enemies still get +1 armour save. Unarmed attacks equal his Attacks and can't be combined with a weapon.

specialRules.name: Lazy
specialRules.description: Does not add exploration dice or search for wyrdstone or rare items unless no Gnoblar Hero is able to.

specialRules.name: Central Figure
specialRules.description: If he is taken out of action, the warband automatically reaches its Rout level.

heroSlots.notes: Gnoblar trackers who hunt for the Ogre. 0-3.

specialRules.name: Greenskin
specialRules.description: Counts as a Greenskin for all purposes but does not suffer Animosity.

specialRules.name: Veteran Tracker
specialRules.description: When hired, choose one special skill for free: Infiltration (only one Trapper in the warband may take it), Set Traps, Netter or Scent Hound.

heroSlots.notes: The unlucky Gnoblar who lures prey for the Sabretusks. 0-1.

specialRules.name: Greenskin
specialRules.description: Counts as a Greenskin for all purposes but does not suffer Animosity.

specialRules.name: Bait
specialRules.description: Once per turn, when a model declares a charge against him and he is not knocked down, stunned or in combat, he may immediately move D6" directly away from the charger. Against a Sabretusk he moves 2D6" instead and may move around models in the way.

henchmenTypes.notes: Common Gnoblars armed with whatever they can find. Any number.

specialRules.name: Greenskin
specialRules.description: Counts as a Greenskin for all purposes but does not suffer Animosity.

specialRules.name: Bicker
specialRules.description: At the start of your turn, roll a D6 for each Gnoblar Henchman not in combat; on a 1 it spends the turn insulting the nearest Gnoblar and may not move, shoot or cast. Lost if it gains That Lad's Got Talent.

henchmenTypes.notes: Gnoblars who pelt the enemy with sharp stuff. 0-7. Only Flingers may buy slings.

specialRules.name: Greenskin
specialRules.description: Counts as a Greenskin for all purposes but does not suffer Animosity.

specialRules.name: Bicker
specialRules.description: At the start of your turn, roll a D6 for each Gnoblar Henchman not in combat; on a 1 it spends the turn insulting the nearest Gnoblar and may not move, shoot or cast. Lost if it gains That Lad's Got Talent.

specialRules.name: Scrap Slinger
specialRules.description: Throws 3 pieces of Sharp Stuff per turn instead of 1. Does not combine with Knife Thrower and does not apply to throwing knives.

henchmenTypes.notes: Young Sabretusks the Ogre is training to hunt. 0-3. Fight with tusks and primal ferocity; carry no equipment.

specialRules.name: Untamed
specialRules.description: Does not Bicker. At the start of each turn roll a D6 for each Sabretusk not in combat; on a 1 it charges 3D6" at the nearest model that is not a Sabretusk. If it charges a member of its own warband, move it 1" away after the combat.

specialRules.name: Charge
specialRules.description: Has 2 Attacks in the turn it charges.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Ogre Club
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Close combat. No profile is printed on the source page (cost 10 gc only).

exclusiveEquipment.name: Harpoon Crossbow
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Missile weapon. No profile is printed on the source page (cost 50 gc only).

exclusiveEquipment.name: Sharp Stuff
exclusiveEquipment.restriction: Gnoblars only. First one free, further ones 3 gc.
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Range 8", Strength 2. No Limit: does not count towards the missile weapon limit. Thrown Weapon: no penalty for moving and shooting or for long range. Targets hit get +1 to their armour save. Stuff Thrower: with Knife Thrower a Gnoblar may throw three pieces instead of one, but not three pieces and three knives in the same turn.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Pigback Mount
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: A pig ridden by a Gnoblar. Profile M5 WS2 BS- S2 T- W1 I3 A1 Ld5. Like a Mount: uses the mounted rules, moves at the mount's speed, cannot climb, can jump obstacles up to 2", uses mounted spear rules, and the rider cannot Infiltrate. Not Like a Mount: not a Large Target, may enter buildings, gives no +1 armour save and may not have barding. Extra Hand: the pig has one free hand holding a free dagger; it may instead be given a club or axe, or a shield (+1 to the rider's save, but the pig can no longer attack).

specialRules: Greenskins: Gnoblars count as Greenskins for all purposes. They do not suffer Animosity but do suffer Bicker. | Bicker: At the start of your turn, roll a D6 for each Gnoblar Henchman not in combat. On a 1 it does nothing but insult the nearest Gnoblar and may not move, shoot or cast that turn. A Gnoblar promoted by That Lad's Got Talent loses Bicker. | Ideas Above Their Station: If the Ogre Hunter dies, the Gnoblar Hero with the highest Leadership becomes leader (highest Experience breaks ties). A new Ogre Hunter may be bought and becomes the leader. | Distasteful Company: The warband may only hire the Hobgoblin Scout, Gnoblar Botcher and Ninja Gnoblar as Hired Swords. Without an Ogre Hunter it may also hire an Ogre Bodyguard and/or Ogre Slaver; hiring a new Ogre Hunter makes all other Ogres leave. | Equipment Limits: Ogres get no free dagger and never fight with daggers. Throwing knives and the Pigback Mount are for Gnoblar Heroes only; slings are for Flingers only. On the Ogre list a Cleaver counts as an axe.
